items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf; Rams optimistic after better Saturday, no setbacks.
items.why: Schefter official active; ETR GTD/optimism; McVay minor calf, Rapoport confirmed.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected; reverse any backup WR beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets return; high ceiling vs Raiders.

items.text: Breece Hall INACTIVE; Jets RB out after GTD-pessimism and limited practice returning from quad.
items.why: Schefter inactives; ETR GTD-pess; Rapoport unlikely pregame as early return.
items.implication: Continued absence opens backfield for others; monitor W8.
items.opportunity: Jets RB committee or backup elevated snaps/carries.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT after being QUESTIONABLE; downgraded for Week 7 vs Bengals. Was close to playing per reports but sits third straight game with ankle.
items.why: ETR weekend summary; Rapoport confirmed downgrade Saturday; close but not ready, expected next week.
items.implication: Ravens offense limited without dual-threat QB; Henry/others volume up but efficiency down.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill players see more work; reverse any prior Lamar beneficiaries if he returns W8.

items.text: Seahawks opening 21-day practice window for Jadarian Price (chest); eligible return W8. Cross high-ankle sprain, hope 1-2 weeks.
items.why: Rapoport + Macdonald; Schefter help on way. Levitan notes JT trade suitors incl SEA, Price status.
items.implication: Potential RB depth boost W8+; OL impact from Cross.
items.opportunity: Price could compete for carries if returns; monitor for role.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins only 21% snaps. Roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: Berry per-player with snap/rush/route data post-return; prior preseason call.
items.implication: Coleman RB upgrade/handcuff breakout; Dobbins clear downgrade.
items.opportunity: Coleman high snap/rush/route share expansion; Dobbins reduced.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) postgame but not certain; was expected lead back pregame.
items.why: Levitan player-specific after ETR listing hamstring with Tracy.
items.implication: Potential limited role or sit W8; monitor practice.
items.opportunity: Backup Giants RBs elevated if limited/out.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide almost certainly fine; would be tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Levitan direct on ETR watch list; purposeful slide context.
items.implication: No major downgrade expected ROS/W8; maintain RB1 status.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for Eagles; Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring).
items.why: ETR summary; NFL.com/injury reports confirm Smith/Wicks out, Barkley Q but expected for MNF.
items.implication: PHI WR corps thinned; more targets to remaining WRs/TEs; Saquon role if active.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route/target share for other Eagles pass-catchers; Saquon goal-line/carries if plays.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected/played; multiple other INs including Mason, Dell, Coleman, Kirk.
items.why: ETR IN list; Schefter/Rapoport activations confirmed expected to play.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome high-value touch RB: worst runner but RB13 PPR ppg via 9 carries inside 5 and league-lead 45 targets.
items.why: Levitan player-specific data on goal-line/targets sustaining fantasy value.
items.implication: Sustainable RB2 despite efficiency; redzone/receiving role key.
items.opportunity: Goal-line carries + target lead among RBs.
items.conflict: Poor runner efficiency vs fantasy production.

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; turn big game into sell-high opportunity in fantasy.
items.why: Berry postgame Love/Hate style take on explosion.
items.implication: Peak value now; trade while high.
items.conflict: One big game vs sustained role/usage.

items.text: Texans routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead, Tank Dell only 6 (return), Noel 15 (left turf toe), Hutchinson 15.
items.why: Levitan postgame routes; Dell first since 2024, limited.
items.implication: Nico clear WR1; Dell ramp-up slow, Noel injury watch.
items.opportunity: Collins high route/target share; Dell low but returning.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury from Sunday not significant; source day-to-day.
items.implication: Likely plays W8 or limited; Mason already active.
items.opportunity: Jordan Mason handcuff elevated if sits.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game no Rice); never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games despite volume. Ceiling note.
items.why: Levitan routes data post-SNF; Rice out hamstring.
items.implication: Volume but efficiency/ceiling concerns without Rice.
items.opportunity: Route share lead; targets up but yardage history caps upside.
items.conflict: High routes vs historical low ceiling production.
